ideas.pitch: A multi-agent sustainability platform utilizing LangGraph and RAG to track, analyze, and optimize energy consumption and waste management across the G.L. Bajaj campus infrastructure.
ideas.title: Campus GreenNovation AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with the innovation-driven sustainability goals of the organizing society, combining localized utility metrics with multi-agent reasoning similar to previous hackathon-winning architectures.

ideas.pitch: AI-powered satellite and aerial imagery monitoring tool to track unauthorized construction, green cover depletion, and land use compliance within institutional zones.
ideas.title: GeoNex-Campus Industrial Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the proven technical complexity of industrial satellite compliance monitoring that secured wins at regional state-sponsored hackathons.

ideas.pitch: Poisson regression and risk forecasting model designed to predict equipment failures, lab safety breaches, and maintenance bottlenecks using historical institutional data.
ideas.title: AI Incident Forecaster for Campus Labs
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates rigorous quantitative modeling and calibrated prediction intervals rather than a superficial wrapper, appealing directly to a judging panel prioritizing feasibility and impact.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered patient acquisition and trust verification engine tailored for local healthcare providers and university campus wellness centers.
ideas.title: MediTrust Patient Trust Engine for Local Clinics
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses real-world healthcare accessibility and trust with a polished user experience, mirroring the rapid-prototype execution style of previous short-duration hackathon winners.

ideas.pitch: Personalized meal recommendation and nutritional insight platform integrated with mess hall menus to promote healthy lifestyle guidance for students.
ideas.title: NutriCampus AI Wellness Assistant
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an immediate, relatable, everyday problem for the student demographic attending the venue, making the impact instantly understandable to judges.
